posts.title: Fantomah Issue #1 Is Now Available
posts.excerpt: The legend continues. Fantomah Issue #1 is now available on Amazon Kindle, featuring two newly reimagined jungle horror adventures alongside their restored classic counterparts.
posts.body:
Fantomah Issue #1 is now live on Amazon Kindle.

This new installment continues our mission of bringing forgotten public domain legends to modern audiences.

Inside this issue:

• Cursed Treasure in the Jungle! – Reimagined Edition
• Mad Science and the Beast-Men! – Reimagined Edition
• Restored classic versions of both original pulp stories
• Publication history and bonus material

As with every AltWorld Comics Classics release, readers can experience both the modern adaptation and the original source material side by side.

Beauty. Terror. Vengeance.

She is Fantomah.

Available now on Amazon Kindle.

posts.title: Fantomah Returns.
posts.excerpt: The first AltWorld Comics release is now live. Fantomah returns in a dark modern reimagining inspired by Golden Age jungle horror.
posts.body:
Fantomah — Issue #0 is officially the first released comic under the AltWorld Comics label.

This special introductory issue reimagines one of the strangest forgotten jungle heroines of the Golden Age through a darker and more cinematic modern lens.

Ancient ruins.
Cursed rituals.
Jungle horror.
Lost civilizations.

Issue #0 acts as the beginning of a larger world while establishing the visual identity and tone of future AltWorld Comics releases.

This is not a simple restoration.

It is a rebirth.

Fantomah returns for a new generation.

posts.title: What Is AltWorld Comics?
posts.excerpt: AltWorld Comics is a dark pulp and retro fantasy comic label focused on forgotten legends, twisted tales and modern mythmaking.
posts.body:
AltWorld Comics was created to bring forgotten worlds back to life.

We focus on dark pulp adventures, retro horror, weird fantasy and reimagined legends inspired by the Golden Age of comics and vintage fantasy storytelling.

Some of our stories rebuild forgotten public domain characters for a modern audience. Others are completely original tales born from the same dark vintage spirit.

Our goal is not simple nostalgia.

We want to preserve the atmosphere, mystery and imagination of classic pulp fiction while combining it with modern cinematic visuals and darker storytelling.

From jungle goddesses and ancient ruins to twisted fairy tales and supernatural horror, AltWorld Comics explores worlds where old myths live again.

Old Tales.
New Adventures.
Different Worlds.

about.heading: About AltWorld Comics
about.body:
AltWorld Comics is an independent dark pulp and retro fantasy comic label focused on both reimagined public domain legends and original dark tales.

We preserve the spirit of vintage adventure, horror and fantasy comics while rebuilding them with modern storytelling, cinematic visuals and a darker atmosphere for a new generation.

From forgotten jungle goddesses to twisted fairy tales, AltWorld Comics explores worlds where old myths live again.
